title: Can't BS the Bond Market: DS Roundtable 1

excerpts.label: Back of yield curve is the risk
excerpts.insight: Jimmy: Long-end yields at range highs, no support underneath—this is where equities derail
excerpts.pm_takeaway: WATCH 10Y/30Y. Range highs with no support = one catalyst away from breakdown. Equities follow.

excerpts.label: Can't BS the bond vigilantes
excerpts.insight: Lots of BS underneath this market—but bond vigilantes can't be fooled like equity investors
excerpts.pm_takeaway: STEEPENERS NOW. Bond vigilantes enforce what politicians won't. Long-end is the canary.

excerpts.label: Hassett = bonds snap down
excerpts.insight: Team unanimous: Hassett pick triggers immediate bond selloff; no technical support below
excerpts.pm_takeaway: FADE HASSETT RISK. If named, yields spike—be ready with 10Y puts or steepeners.

excerpts.label: Gold above 4,000 is FOMO
excerpts.insight: Nik: Gold rip past 3,500 is pure FOMO into small market—no macro signal, silver even worse
excerpts.pm_takeaway: NO NEW GOLD POSITIONS. Last $500 is technical break + FOMO, not fundamentals. Wait for pullback.

excerpts.label: Oil screaming buy if 56 holds
excerpts.insight: Gap down on Venezuela but hold 56 = screaming buy; break below = test low 50s/40s
excerpts.pm_takeaway: BUY OIL on gap-hold at 56. Bad news + good price action = classic setup. Stop below 55.

excerpts.label: Steepener if tariffs illegal
excerpts.insight: If SCOTUS rules tariffs illegal, 2-10s could blow out to 120-250bps—massive steepener play
excerpts.pm_takeaway: LOAD STEEPENERS before SCOTUS decision. Illegal ruling = deficit blowout = curve explosion.
